div.div: Deterministic Math Engine (Swabi 4.8 PSH, Derating, Tariffs)
Trigger: User uploads a competitor's quote via App/WhatsApp
API: Localhost HTTP POST to Ollama
Prompt: Extract panels, inverter, and structure pricing
Logic: Compare extracted prices vs. live wholesale market rates
n8n Drafts a polite counter-offer highlighting unfair markups
n8n Auto-Replies to customer via WhatsApp with the script
Android APK (No active internet required for core math)
